business.about: Navin Fluorine International Ltd is primary engaged in producing refrigeration gases, inorganic fluorides, specialty organofluorines and offers contract research and manufacturing services. [1] Its portfolio includes 50+ fluorinated compounds developed over the years. [2]
business.in_their_words: This result reflects our continued focus on strengthening our business, building capabilities for the future and advancing our strategic priorities through disciplined execution. As we navigate the evolving business environment, our priority remains to strengthen our business fundamentals and deliver sustainable growth across all verticals. We are also making steady progress in developing Advanced Materials as a potential growth platform over the longer term. We are focusing on specialized applications across areas such as data centers, electronics, semiconductors and defense, leveraging our expertise in fluorination chemistry and R&D capability. We are confident this business will create additional growth opportunities for us. results.read: Revenue +57% YoY; EBITDA margin expanded 172 bps YoY to 34%; PAT +82% — profits outran sales.

calls: Growth is decelerating: revenue CAGR 16.9% over 3y vs 23.0% over 5y
Margins expanding: 33% latest vs 24% average of prior years
Strong cash conversion: 5-yr operating cash flow is 1.20× reported profit
